title: Yellow Crispy Moroccan Lamb Couscous Royal
description: A malty and crispy Moroccan dish featuring lamb and couscous, cooked to perfection in a ttukbaegi earthenware pot, dairy-free friendly.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the ttukbaegi earthenware pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the lamb pieces and cook until they are browned on all sides.
Add the ground cumin, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add 2 cups of water to the pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 hour.
Add the couscous to the pot and stir to combine.
Cover the pot and cook for an additional 10 minutes, or until the couscous is tender and the liquid has been absorbed.
Fluff the couscous with a fork and serve hot.
